description: Olaniru 2023 fetal pancreas pseudobulk: raw-count sums, gene x profile (specimen|cell type)
upstream: Raw-count sums of every gene over the cells of each specimen and published cell type of Olaniru 2023 (GSE197064, human fetal pancreas, 12 to 20 weeks post-conception), from Cell Ranger 9.0.1 counts of the public reads (GRCh38-2024-A) with cells assigned to specimens by the authors' deposited sample maps; cell types were matched to the cells from the authors' web viewer, because the study deposited no cell-level label table; cells without a cell type or specimen are left out.

description: Yu 2021b fetal pancreas pseudobulk: raw-count sums, gene x profile (embryo|cell type)
upstream: Raw-count sums of every gene over the cells of each embryo and published cell type of Yu 2021b (OMIX236, whole human fetal pancreas, seven embryos aged 8 to 19 weeks), from the authors' deposited count matrix and cell annotation (the whole-pancreas cells; the endocrine-enriched cells are left out).
